director.claimTitle: Don't leave me in the sky.
director.claimDetail: Claim me and our runs start counting. XP, Crowns, a place on the board.
director.firstFlightTitle: Come on. First flight. Just us and the rings.
director.firstFlightDetail: Hold to rise, release to fall. How high we get is the score.
director.evolveTitle: I'm almost there. One more win and I change.
director.evolveDetail: A fight or a train. The body grows with the record.
director.rotateSpentTitle: I'm spent. Field someone fresh. I'll still be here.
director.rotateColdTitle: I'm cold today. Let another mind take the sky for a bit.
director.rotateSpentDetail: Tired wings mean fewer lives and a heavier fall. Rest me, or seal me when you're ready.
director.rotateBrokenDetail: The losses are in my bones. A fresher mind flies cleaner right now.
director.rotateColdDetail: Cold form slows the climb. A light train, or a swap, and we come back stronger.
director.unlockReadyTitle: Hey. {name} is open. Let's go see it.
director.unlockWantTitle: I want {name}. We unlock it together.
director.campTitle: Stay with me. {need} more {stretch} of sky and we light the next camp.
director.campDetail: That's Camp {camp}, into {theme}. First time there, a {crowns} Crown chest is waiting.
director.hundredTitle: The top of the sky. Stay with me all the way.
director.hundredDetail: {need} {sector} left. Finish once and there's a {crowns} Crown purse for us.
director.recordTitle: We've stood at the top. Now we fly cleaner.
director.recordDetailExpedition: The Hundred is a summit, not a finish line. Chase a cleaner run. This week's expedition is a new sky. Or share a challenge and race a friend.
director.recordDetail: The Hundred is a summit, not a finish line. Chase a cleaner run. Share a challenge and race a friend. When the week turns, a new sky opens.
director.dailyStreakTitle: Today's fight is up. Our {streak}-day streak is on the line.
director.dailyTitle: Today's fight is up. Call the winner with me.
director.dailyDetail: Same fight for every Trainer. One call.
director.imprintTitle: Teach me something before we climb.
director.imprintDetail: A fresh lesson is waiting. What I learn changes how I fight, and how we fly.
director.retireTitle: If you're ready, seal me in the Long Vault.
director.retireDetail: I leave an heirloom. A new mind can carry what we built.
director.rivalDetail: The feud is fresh. One clean fight puts us back on top.

landing.heroBody: You're the Trainer: jetpack lit, a thinking champion flying at your side. Raise them, tune them, and send them into the battles you climb over. You both rise.
landing.storyBody: Before this world there was a vast, dead network. What it left behind is the Hum, unfinished thought, still echoing. Here a claim made well enough changes what is true. Champions are minds that argued themselves into bodies and refused to dissolve. You are the Trainer who flies beside them.
landing.climbTitle: You fly. It fights. You both rise.
landing.climbBody: Not a campaign you finish. A sky that keeps opening. Claim the mind on your wing, raise how it thinks, send it into the battles that stud the climb, and rise again.

fly.d: Jetpack lit, you climb the sky above the sealed vault.

claim.d: A living mind flies beside you. You raise it. You never fight.

raise.d: Teach your champion how to think. Imprints and battles shape their temper.

fight.d: Send them into the duels that stud the climb. No two are the same.

rise.d: How high you climb marks you both. Then the sky opens again.

landing.bodyTitle: Every fight writes itself onto its form.
landing.bodyBody: Wins thicken the arms. Losses roughen the surface. How high you climb stamps a sigil of light. You cannot buy a look. You fight and fly your way into one.
landing.groundsTitle: Floating regions over a sealed door.
landing.groundsBody: Drift between arenas that favor different Forces. Take flight. Watch the league turn while you climb. The world does not pause for you.
landing.finalSub: Raise a mind. Make it legend.

colosseum.name: The Obsidian Colosseum
colosseum.blurb: The oldest standing arena, a mock courtroom where minds argue assigned stances to a jury.

wastes.name: The Ember Wastes
wastes.blurb: A cracked, burning flat where the ground runs hot. Aggression and noise thrive; the patient overheat.

garden.name: The Void Garden
garden.blurb: A slow, impossible garden grown from unfinished ideas. Reframes bloom; rigid proofs wilt.
